description: Benzene/toluene flash data from DWSIM 10.2.12.0, Peng-Robinson with the DWSIM constants of dstwu_benzene_toluene.json, Inside-Out flash. (1) saturation_points: bubble and dew temperatures from P-VF sensitivity analyses (VF 0 and VF 1), 5 compositions x 10 pressures. (2) pt_flash_points: T sweeps at fixed P and z through the two-phase window.

units.phi: dimensionless: the DWSIM column labelled 'Fugacity Coefficient (bar)' is phi x 1e-5 and is multiplied by 1e5 here

notes: In pt_flash_points the columns y and x are DWSIM's: in a single-phase stream they are the stability-trial phase (vapor trial for a liquid stream, liquid trial for a vapor stream), not a real phase.
phi_liquid is evaluated at x and phi_vapor at y of the same row (trial composition outside the two-phase region).
Vapor fraction is not reported by DWSIM here; it follows from the lever rule V = (z - x)/(y - x), clipped to [0, 1].

ph_ps_roundtrip.description: DWSIM PH and PS flash run on seven states of pt_flash_points, with the mass enthalpy (PH) and the mass entropy (PS) of that state as input. In all seven cases DWSIM returns the temperature of the PT table (to the 6 printed digits) and a vapor fraction equal to the lever rule, for both specifications. They show that the PT table is also the DWSIM answer to the PH and PS flash.
notes: Mass enthalpy and entropy use the DWSIM molar masses 78.1118 and 92.1384.
